description:
Get your wallet balance, your spending limits, and whether you can add money by card now.
Use for: checking what you can spend before you fund a bounty or send money, and reading your limits.
Not for: money that came in or went out (list_wallet_transactions).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_wallet({})
Errors: account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: get_wallet

balance.description: Your stored wallet balance, earnings kept in the wallet included. Sends and bounty funding are checked against it.

lowBalanceAlertAt.description: You get an email when your balance falls below this. Left out: off.

spendingCapPer24h.description: The most your wallet pays in any 24 hours. Left out: off.

spendingCapPerBounty.description: The most your wallet funds for one bounty’s hires and prepaid spots; excludes tips and reimbursements. Left out: off.

isAvailable.description: Whether this account can add money by card now.

setupUrl.description: Where to finish account setup so money can be added. Left out when no step on your side fixes it.

title: Get your wallet
